leadText: Jun Fukuyama (Japanese: 福山潤 Fukuyama Jun) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Jun Fukuyama (Japanese: 福山潤 Fukuyama Jun) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Fukuyama was born on November 26, 1978 in , , and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Fukuyama started out voicing various characters of the day during and . Later, he voiced for the spin-off series of Pokémon Generations. In , Fukuyama gained his most notable role as Hau, one of 's rivals. Fukuyama was once affiliated with Production Baobab before he switched to Black ship. He also won both Best Leading Actor and Overseas Fan's Award during the of 2007 and the of 2009, respectively.
